chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far عليه السلام: When the funeral prayer becomes due at the time of an obligatory prayer, which of the two should I begin with? He said: Hasten the deceased to his grave, unless you fear that the time of the obligatory prayer will pass. And do not delay the prayer over the جنازة until sunrise or sunset.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral prayer performed over the deceased
key_terms.عَجِّلِ الْمَيِّتَ: hasten the deceased without unnecessary delay
key_terms.قَبْرِهِ: his grave, meaning burial is to be expedited
key_terms.وَقْتُ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the fixed time of the obligatory prayer

ai.seo_question: If the funeral prayer and an obligatory prayer coincide, which one should be performed first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about priority between salat over the deceased and an obligatory prescribed prayer when their times coincide. It instructs that the deceased should be hastened to burial, except when there is fear that the time of the obligatory prayer will lapse, and it forbids delaying the funeral prayer until sunrise or sunset.
